## Validation

<!-- List the exact commands run and their results. -->

- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `bun run build:frontend` for frontend-only changes
- [ ] `bun run build:single` for native, IPC, tooling, packaging, or resource changes

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and belongs in the framework repository.
- [ ] Tests cover the fix or reusable logic where practical.
- [ ] Public TypeScript types match native IPC behavior.
- [ ] Chinese and English documentation are updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Security, permissions, compatibility, and binary-size impact were considered.
- [ ] No generated output, local configuration, personal paths, or secrets are included.
